ui_bugs.issue: The .btn-primary CSS class in app/globals.css (lines 117–128) declares `display: inline-flex` OUTSIDE any @layer. Tailwind's `.hidden { display:none }` sits inside `@layer utilities` and therefore loses the cascade to the layer-less rule. Result: `<Link className='btn-primary hidden sm:inline-flex' data-testid='nav-login-btn'>Login</Link>` and `<button className='btn-primary ... ' data-testid='footer-subscribe-btn'>` are ALWAYS shown as inline-flex, even at <640px where `hidden` should have taken effect.
ui_bugs.impact_high: On 360x740 (Galaxy S8+), the still-visible LOGIN pill in the header pushes the total header content width to 389px, so the mobile hamburger (data-testid='nav-mobile-toggle') sits at x=349–389 and gets clipped by `body { overflow-x:hidden }`. Users on 360px devices CANNOT open the mobile menu when logged out (i.e. on /, /login, /admin pre-login, or any deep link that redirects to /login).

ui_bugs.issue: footer-subscribe-btn (same .btn-primary root cause) extends to x=364 on a 360px viewport (~4px past viewport). The parent pill container `.flex items-center gap-2 p-1 pl-4 rounded-full` doesn't shrink enough on very small screens.

critical_code_review_comments: app/globals.css: `.btn-primary` (line 117) and `.btn-ghost` (line 132) are declared OUTSIDE `@layer components`, so ANY Tailwind utility (hidden, block, w-full, py-*, px-*) applied to elements using these classes may be silently overridden. This has already been worked around with `!important` variants (`!py-2.5 !px-4 !text-[0.7rem]` on footer-subscribe-btn) — the correct fix is to move these two rules into `@layer components { ... }`.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: `.btn-primary { display: inline-flex; ... }` in app/globals.css sits outside `@layer components`. In Tailwind v4, `@layer utilities` rules are scoped inside a lower-priority cascade layer than un-layered stylesheet rules. Thus `.hidden { display: none }` (which is inside `@layer utilities`) loses to `.btn-primary { display: inline-flex }` (un-layered) regardless of source order. Reproduction: open https://<host>/login on a 360px-wide device (or DevTools mobile emulation 360x740) — you will see the pink LOGIN pill in the top-right AND the hamburger button clipped/off-screen. Mitigation: wrap the two button base classes in `@layer components { }` so Tailwind's utility layer can override them, or use a wrapping element with `hidden sm:inline-flex` rather than applying `hidden` directly to the button/link that has `.btn-primary`.
